name: browserless
description: Browserless.io browser automation for Claude — an interactive web agent plus scraping, search, crawling, export, and Lighthouse audits

browserless_token.title: Browserless API token
browserless_token.description: API token for the hosted Browserless MCP server, from your account at https://www.browserless.io/account/home. Stored in your system's secure credential store.

api_url.title: Browserless API URL
api_url.description: Hosted region the MCP server uses: https://production-sfo.browserless.io (default), https://production-lon.browserless.io, https://production-ams.browserless.io, or another https://*.browserless.io URL such as a dedicated deployment. Self-hosted URLs work only with the REST skills; leave the default here.
